# cicd tools

CI/CD integration - GitHub Actions and GitLab CI workflow status and management

6 tools. All categories: [MCP Tool Catalog](README.md).

## `ci_cancel_run`

Cancel a running CI/CD workflow or pipeline, auto-detecting the forge from the remote URL.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [cicd/ci_cancel_run.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/cicd/ci_cancel_run.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string | yes | Golden repository alias name (e.g. 'myrepo-global') |
| `run_id` | integer | yes | Workflow run ID (GitHub) or pipeline ID (GitLab) to cancel |
| `forge` | string (one of: `auto`, `github`, `gitlab`) | no | Force a specific forge type, or 'auto' to detect from remote URL |

## `ci_list_runs`

List CI/CD runs for a repository, auto-detecting GitHub Actions or GitLab CI from the remote URL.

- Permission: `repository:read`
- Source: [cicd/ci_list_runs.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/cicd/ci_list_runs.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string | yes | Golden repository alias name (e.g. 'myrepo-global') |
| `forge` | string (one of: `auto`, `github`, `gitlab`) | no | Force a specific forge type, or 'auto' to detect from remote URL |

| `status` | string | no | Optional status filter (e.g. completed, failed, running) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of runs to return (default: 20). |
